title: Economy
description: Economy coverage follows prices, jobs, benefits, business, debt, housing, interest rates, trade, consumer decisions, and financial markets.
editorialFrame: Koios.News begins with what an economic change means for people and institutions; systems analysis follows only where it clarifies the witnessed event.
seedTerms: sovereign debt and the global south

title: Environment
description: Environment coverage from Koios.News follows sourced events, useful questions, people, institutions, and changes concerning environment.
editorialFrame: Koios.News reports environment on its own terms. Collapse, infrastructure, state capacity, capital, and physical limits are optional analytical perspectives, never conditions for coverage.

title: Technology
description: Technology coverage follows products, research, software, AI, semiconductors, space, security, companies, labor, and policy.
editorialFrame: Koios.News reports the product or event first, then uses material infrastructure, labor, capital, regulation, and power as analytical lenses when the evidence warrants them.

title: Newsroom
description: Newsroom coverage explains Koios.News as a publication system: its editorial standards, autonomous tools, feeds, source surfaces, and operating constraints.
editorialFrame: These stories make the machinery visible so readers and operators can inspect how the site turns sourced evidence into public news objects.
